title: One-step oracle read
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number, let $w,E$ be bit strings, let $o$ be an oracle, and let $[0m\tau$ be a task. Suppose that on every encoding of a natural number $p$, the oracle returns the $p$th bit of $E$, defaulting to false beyond its end. If the scan instruction at label $l$ is a read instruction with successor labels $l_1,l_0$, then one machine step from label $l$ with registers $(p,c,a)$ leaves the registers unchanged and moves to $l_1$ if the $p$th bit of $E$ (default false) is true, and to $l_0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: Oracle answers on encoded natural numbers equal the corresponding E bit, defaulting to false
scan τ l equals the read instruction with labels l₁,l₀
